title: Character expectation and polynomial roots
statement: Let $\ell>0$, let $\gamma$ be a $d$-coordinate binary vector, let $a$ map each element of $\mathbb F_{2^\ell}$ to a $d$-tuple over that field, and let $p$ be a nonzero polynomial over $\mathbb F_{2^\ell}$. Suppose $p(r)=\sum_i\gamma_i a(r)_i$ for every field element $r$. The average of the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ on the generated vector, when its two field inputs are chosen independently and uniformly, equals the number of roots of $p$ in $\mathbb F_{2^\ell}$ divided by $2^\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ maps each field element to a $d$-tuple over the binary extension field
$p$ is a nonzero polynomial over the binary extension field
